# statusdrift_incident (Resource)

Manages a StatusDrift incident.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "statusdrift_incident" "api_outage" {
  monitor_id = statusdrift_monitor.api_health.id
  message    = "API is returning 500 errors intermittently"
  priority   = "high"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `monitor_id` (Number) The ID of the monitor this incident belongs to.

### Optional

- `message` (String) The incident message.
- `priority` (String) The incident priority: low, medium, high, or critical.
- `resolved` (Boolean) Whether the incident has been resolved. Set to true to resolve the incident.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the incident.
